decisions.reason: The backfill waiver concerns historical reward-accounting records, while this Requirement's current attributes govern metadata visibility and referral-code identity and remain unchanged.
Waiving backfill of missing accounting records does not change ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, or reset behavior.
The decision does not change fiat-buyer wallet provisioning, reward receipt, or reward-access behavior.
The source decision does not request any About-page copy change and does not contradict its current content.
The historical backfill waiver does not alter the Mission page's descriptions of referral rewards or project values.
The source concerns accounting for primary-mint rewards and does not change secondary-sale royalties, marketplace controls, or ticket exclusion for secondary sales.
The decision does not change email delivery, confirmation contents, or reward-notification requirements.
The historical accounting-backfill decision does not change the Transak provider, payment methods, conversion, or mint fulfillment.
The source decision concerns missing ticket and commission accounting and does not change badge definitions, milestones, storage, or display.
The FAQ's forward-looking reward explanations remain valid, and the source does not require disclosing or correcting historical accounting data.
The client still requires future no-referral commissions and tickets to be randomly allocated; only historical accounting backfill was waived, so allocation behavior remains unchanged.
The backfill waiver does not change which NFT state, badges, referral code, book access, or prize tickets transfer on resale.
